title: Rena's Smile Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in Seaside Proper, Rena's Smile is sure to have you smiling the minute you enter this beautiful 3 bedroom beach cottage! Enjoy a gourmet kitchen, open living spaces inside and outside, and gorgeous ocean views from your private tower!
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in Seaside, 6 houses down from the beach - Private beach access at the NATCHEZ pavilion access - 30 second walk to the largest Family Pool - Short walk to the beach, community pools, shopping, and dining - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - You will have a total of 6 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Optional access to Seaside's private pools and fitness center (additional fee applies) - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Located in Seaside Proper, and 6 homes from the beach, Rena's Smile is sure to have you smiling the minute you enter this beautiful 3-bedroom beach cottage! For more sleeping space inquire about Rena's Smile's sister property, Golden Lady! When rented together this becomes a 4 bedroom with loft, sleeping up to 12. When entering this cozy cottage, you will notice the beautiful colorful coastal decor and great layout. All three bedrooms complete the first floor making for a spacious and open entertaining area upstairs. Natural light coming in from all angles upstairs create a warm inviting area for everyone to gather. The kitchen is well equipped for all your needs. This home's incredible location is just a quick and beautiful walk to the sugar-white sand and sparkling emerald waters. Experience the best dining, shopping, and entertainment along 30A within walking and biking distance. Guests in this home will also enjoy access to three immaculate community pools (including one conveniently located just across the street), tennis courts, a playground, volleyball and a fitness center. ACCOMODATIONS: (Sleeps 6): 1st floor- Bedroom 1: Queen bed with a private bathroom (shower only) Bedroom 2: Queen bed with TV and a private bathroom (bath/shower combo) Bedroom 3: Bunk bed (sleeps 2) with a TV and a private half bath Laundry room 2nd floor- Open living / dining space with a flat screen TV, gourmet kitchen, half bath and access to the upper balcony. Up one more flight of stairs is where you'll enjoy the best views in the house from your very own crow's nest. Ocean and town views surround Rena's Smile. Sit back, relax and take in all that Seaside has to offer from your very own tower! Perfect spot to catch sunset. IMPORANT DETAILS: ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. **** Rena's Smile is attached on the second level with outside decking to its sister property Golden Lady. The homes are completely private and usually rented to different groups, with their own outdoor, private seating spaces and separate outdoor showers, however, can be rented together as a GREAT dual family option as well. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside amenities: Playground, Pickleball Courts, Tennis Courts, Croquet Lawn, Basketball, 3 community pools including a covered pool, Adult only pool and Family pool, Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. * Sorry, no pets allowed. * Parking for 2 cars FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
